correctness.rationale: The known ideal/filter one-point extension profile gives t(G)=2i(G)+i(bar G)-2^|A|-2^|B|. Inserting ab destroys precisely i(G[R]) independent sets of G and removing ab from bar G creates i(bar G[S]); substitution yields the signed Delta formula. Since R and S partition n-2 vertices, independent-set extremal bounds give exact inequalities 1-2^(n-1)<=Delta<=2^(n-2)-2 and their unique graph equality cases. The promised-edge construction realizes an arbitrary bipartite graph H as bar G[S], so D=Delta+2=i(H), a #P-complete exact counting function. Independent exhaustive n<=5 graph tests reconstructed the identities and located the incorrect original slogan claim: for n=4, attainable deltas are only {-7,-5,-2,1,2}, not every integer in [-7,2]. The supplied complete replacement SLOGAN removes this false interval-filling assertion; RESULT.md and proof are preserved unchanged.
residual_risks: Computational bounded checks are not proofs for infinite or continuum assertions; critical analytic steps were reconstructed.
